notes: Demo stand-in markets for markets/trading.py: series ticker -> a market ticker open on Kalshi's DEMO exchange.
Used only when the hedge's own ticker is not listed (open) on demo. An order on a stand-in is logged and labeled 'demo stand-in, not the production contract'.

Checked 2026-10-25 against https://demo-api.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2: demo lists the same series and tickers as production for KXRAIN (incl. -NYC), KXHIGHNY, KXNBAGAME, KXNHLGAME, KXNBAPLAYOFF, KXNHLPLAYOFF, so no stand-in is needed today. KXNBASERIES/KXNHLSERIES had no open markets (off-season), and the retired KXRAINNYC series has none.
Example: "stand_ins": {"KXNBASERIES": "KXNBAGAME-26OCT28NYKCHI-NYK"}. Daily/game tickers expire, so update before a demo.
